clips.heading: CRITICAL SECURITY BULLETIN
clips.text: Welcome to Weekly Cyber News. I'm @ME, bringing you an urgent security bulletin on a breaking exploit.

clips.heading: ZERO-DAY EXPLOIT DISCOVERED
clips.text: Security researchers have identified an active zero-day attack targeting core infrastructure servers worldwide.

clips.heading: ATTACK VECTOR TIMELINE
clips.text: The exploit utilizes an unauthenticated API endpoint to execute remote code with elevated system privileges.

clips.heading: THREAT ACTOR PROFILE
clips.text: Cyber intelligence attributes this campaign to sophisticated state-sponsored threat actors using custom malware.

clips.heading: IMMEDIATE PATCH ACTION
clips.text: CISA has issued an emergency directive ordering all organizations to apply security patches immediately.

clips.heading: OUTRO & COMMUNITY CTA
clips.text: Stay protected, patch your systems, and follow @NajeebCyber for continuous 24/7 zero-day alerts.
